$schema-note: Window-title dwell scenarios, shared by two test suites so the probe simulation and the
production rule cannot drift apart unnoticed:
The probe suite also checks that 'divergence' explains any difference from the expected
production count. Readings default to origin
'poll'; a null title means the title could not be read.
windowRecords counts window-track records: the production side counts distinct staged window
records, the probe side reports DwellOutcome.WindowRecords.

scenarios.name: repeated-readings-are-not-changes
scenarios.why: Polling re-reports the same value; a repeat is not a change on either side.

scenarios.name: spinner-frames-never-settle
scenarios.why: A three-frame spinner at ~0.96s per frame outlives no dwell window; the title that follows it does.

scenarios.name: navigation-intermediate-state-is-absorbed
scenarios.why: The address bar shows up first and is overwritten; only the page title settles.

scenarios.name: application-switch-needs-no-dwell
scenarios.why: A switch is not noise: the new window's title is accepted however briefly it is held.

scenarios.name: zero-dwell-accepts-every-confirmed-change
scenarios.why: With no dwell every change that a later reading confirms becomes its own record.

scenarios.name: unreadable-title
scenarios.why: A reading with no title: the window observation stops, the foreground application does not.
scenarios.divergence: Deliberate: the production rule ends the window record and opens nothing for an unreadable title, while the probe treats 'title unavailable' as one more observed value so the gap is visible in the churn report. Probe dwell counts are therefore an upper bound whenever titles go unreadable; the probe reports titleUnavailableReadings alongside them for that reason.

scenarios.name: zero-dwell-last-reading-has-nothing-to-confirm-it
scenarios.why: The last reading of a session introduces a new title that no later reading confirms.
scenarios.divergence: Deliberate: production settles a pending title on the next reading, so a title introduced by the final reading is not written yet, while the probe measures the trailing hold against the end of the probe and counts it at dwell 0. The difference is bounded by one record at the tail of a session.
